svg.title: A note travels with its element
svg.desc: A diagram element may carry a short Markdown note; the model validates it once, and the SVG, the CLI, and the reviewer each read it.

g.aria-label: A note travels with its element
g.desc: An AI author can annotate any node, edge, group, text, or title it draws. Hover, focus, or tap an element on this slide to read its note.

text.tspan: A note travels with its element

g.desc: Writes note in an apply-slide request, or sets it later with a diagram edit update op; null clears it.
Rendered with the reviewer's sanitizing Markdown helper and shown beside the element. The next slide shows how.

g.aria-label: Tests: validation, byte-stable rendering, round trips

text.tspan: Tests: validation, byte-stable rendering, round trips

g.desc: On every apply-slide and diagram edit, and again whenever a Saga loads, so validate reports a hand-edited unsafe note.
